Definition (EN): to be in contact
Quote from Episode: have you been in touch with Elliott?
台词翻译: 你和 Elliott 还有联系吗？
Example Sentence: Keep in touch with me after the handover.
例句翻译: 交接完以后跟我保持联系。
Usage Note: 职场/关系高频。get in touch with＝联系上。

Definition (EN): to put money into an account
Quote from Episode: Could you not deposit this until Monday?
台词翻译: 这张支票能不能先别存到周一？
Example Sentence: She deposited the cheque the morning the rent was due.
例句翻译: 房租到期那天早上她才去存的支票。
Usage Note: 英式拼 cheque／deposit，美式 check。名词 a deposit ＝订金/押金。

Definition (EN): a feeling of slight pain or unease
Quote from Episode: Call if the discomfort's too much.
台词翻译: 要是不舒服得受不了就打给我。
Example Sentence: The side effects cause discomfort rather than pain.
例句翻译: 副作用带来的是不适而不是疼痛。
Usage Note: discomfort／discomforting／discomforted。搭配 at ease 的反义。

Definition (EN): a process where substances combine and change
Quote from Episode: Explosions are the result of chemical reactions happening almost instantaneously.
台词翻译: 爆炸是化学反应几乎瞬间发生的结果。
Example Sentence: The reaction releases heat and changes the colour.
例句翻译: 这个反应会放热并改变颜色。
Usage Note: 动词 react；名词 reactant（反应物）／product（产物）。

Definition (EN): in an instant
Quote from Episode: chemical reactions happening almost instantaneously
台词翻译: 几乎瞬间就发生的化学反应
Example Sentence: The two compounds react instantaneously on contact.
例句翻译: 这两种化合物一接触就瞬间反应。
Usage Note: 形容词 instantaneous。≈ in an instant。

Definition (EN): to keep secret or not reveal
Quote from Episode: is there anything else you're holding back from your family?
台词翻译: 你是不是还有什么瞒着家里？
Example Sentence: He held back the numbers until the audit was done.
例句翻译: 他把数字瞒到审计结束才说。
Usage Note: hold sth back＝藏着不说；hold someone back＝拖住某人。

Definition (EN): to stop shutting them out emotionally
释义（中文）: 让某人进入你的世界；对某人敞开心扉
Quote from Episode: Walt when you don't let me in
台词翻译: Walt，你把我关在门外的时候……
Example Sentence: Managers who don't let people in lose their best staff.
例句翻译: 不让人敞开心扉的管理者会失去最好的员工。
Usage Note: 情感义。in 用于关系，into 用于场合（let you into the team）。

Definition (EN): to have no information and be kept guessing
Quote from Episode: we're just left wondering where you are
台词翻译: 我们只能干等着猜你在哪儿。
Example Sentence: Supporters were left wondering whether the site would ever return.
例句翻译: 支持者只能等着，不知道网站还会不会回来。
Usage Note: be left + V-ing＝被动地处在某种处境。

Definition (EN): having a healing or calming effect
释义（中文）: 有疗愈作用的；让人放松的
Quote from Episode: It's really very therapeutic.
台词翻译: 这真的很有治愈感。
Example Sentence: Gardening turned out to be unexpectedly therapeutic.
例句翻译: 园艺意外地很治愈。
Usage Note: 名词 therapy／therapist。口语也指「像在做治疗一样」。

Definition (EN): feeling very hot, often with fever
Quote from Episode: I'm burning up.
台词翻译: 我烧得厉害。
Example Sentence: He was burning up by the time the ambulance arrived.
例句翻译: 救护车到的时候他已经烧得很厉害了。
Usage Note: 发烧说法。＝ have a fever。也可指「着火了」。

Definition (EN): to look extremely pale and haggard
释义（中文）: 脸色苍白憔悴（像刚从微波炉里爬出来）
Quote from Episode: looks like you just crawled out of a microwave.
台词翻译: 你看起来就像刚从微波炉里爬出来。
Example Sentence: After three red-eyes he looked like he crawled out of a microwave.
例句翻译: 连熬三个通宵后他憔悴得不行。
Usage Note: 美式俚语。同类：look like death warmed over。

Definition (EN): to die
Quote from Episode: You want to make some cash for your people before you check out.
台词翻译: 你是在想着趁还在的时候给家里留点钱。
Example Sentence: He paid off the house before his father checked out.
例句翻译: 他在父亲去世前把房贷还清了。
Usage Note: 极委婉说法。更正式的 euphemism 是 pass away。

Definition (EN): a small organ that filters lymph
Quote from Episode: Gone to your lymph nodes.
台词翻译: 已经扩散到你的淋巴结了。
Example Sentence: Stage two means it has reached the lymph nodes.
例句翻译: 二期意味着已经扩散到淋巴结。
Usage Note: 复数 lymph nodes。淋巴系统，癌症分期关键指标。

Definition (EN): a phase of a disease's development
Quote from Episode: What stage are you?
台词翻译: 你这是几期？
Example Sentence: It was caught at stage one, which is why the outlook is good.
例句翻译: 是一期发现的，所以预后还不错。
Usage Note: 医学义＝分期；通用义＝阶段。stage I/II/III/IV。

Definition (EN): chemotherapy
Quote from Episode: The next time, put an ice pack on your head during chemo.
台词翻译: 下次化疗的时候头上敷个冰袋。
Example Sentence: He did six rounds of chemo and kept working.
例句翻译: 他做了六个疗程的化疗，还一直在上班。
Usage Note: 口语缩写，正式 chemotherapy。＝ chemo treatment／chemo session。

Definition (EN): to complete a set of work done in one run
Quote from Episode: You going to be able to finish the batch?
台词翻译: 这批你做得完吗？
Example Sentence: We have to finish the batch before the shift ends.
例句翻译: 这批必须在下班前做完。
Usage Note: batch＝一批；生产/后厨/实验室通用。

Definition (EN): a lot of money
Quote from Episode: I'm out there making fat stacks, man.
台词翻译: 我在外面赚着大把钞票呢，老兄。
Example Sentence: He's making fat stacks on the used-car lot.
例句翻译: 他在二手车行赚得盆满钵满。
Usage Note: 俚语。a stack ＝一叠（通常 1000 美元）。

Definition (EN): to sell drugs, especially to buyers
Quote from Episode: I've been out there all night slinging crystal.
台词翻译: 我整晚在外面兜售冰毒。
Example Sentence: He got busted for slinging weed out of his apartment.
例句翻译: 他因为在公寓里卖大麻被抓。
Usage Note: 名词 a slinger＝毒贩。同义 peddle、deal。

Definition (EN): an amount of drugs large enough to trigger a felony charge
Quote from Episode: but would you be interested in a felony quantity of methamphetamine?
台词翻译: 但你对大量冰毒有兴趣吗？
Example Sentence: He was arrested with a felony quantity of cocaine.
例句翻译: 他被查到持有大量可卡因，按重罪起诉。
Usage Note: 美国法律分级：misdemeanor（轻罪）／felony（重罪）。

Definition (EN): near the top of a hierarchy
Quote from Episode: look, he's upper level, man.
台词翻译: 你看，他是大人物，老兄。
Example Sentence: Only upper-level staff see the full financial data.
例句翻译: 只有高层员工能看到完整的财务数据。
Usage Note: 职场层级：entry-level／mid-level／upper-level／executive。

Definition (EN): to deal or trade with them
Quote from Episode: He's not going to do business with some dude he doesn't know.
台词翻译: 他不会跟一个他不认识的人做生意。
Example Sentence: We don't do business with anyone under forty.
例句翻译: 我们不跟四十岁以下的人做生意。
Usage Note: 常见搭配：do business with／in。＝ have dealings with。

Definition (EN): to approach someone forcefully with no introduction
Quote from Episode: You can't just bum rush some high-level ice man and start cutting deals, okay?
台词翻译: 你不能直接硬闯去找一个大毒枭谈交易，明白吗？
Example Sentence: Don't bum rush the CFO — get an introduction first.
例句翻译: 别硬闯 CFO 的办公室，先找个人引荐。
Usage Note: 职场也有：别一上来就找老板硬谈。

Definition (EN): to negotiate and agree terms
释义（中文）: 谈成一笔交易；达成协议
Quote from Episode: We got a deal.
台词翻译: 成交。
Example Sentence: They cut a deal that kept both vendors alive.
例句翻译: 他们谈成了一笔让两家供应商都活下来的协议。
Usage Note: 职场超高频。＝ strike／close a deal（签成）。

Definition (EN): to be introduced to someone useful
Quote from Episode: You need an intro.
台词翻译: 你需要一个引荐。
Example Sentence: Can you get me an intro to the head of design?
例句翻译: 你能帮我引荐一下设计负责人吗？
Usage Note: intro 是 introduction 的口语缩写。＝ warm introduction。

Definition (EN): to speak in support of their character
Quote from Episode: You need someone to vouch.
台词翻译: 你得有人替你说句话。
Example Sentence: Will your former manager vouch for you?
例句翻译: 你以前的经理愿意替你作保吗？
Usage Note: ＝ back／endorse。vouch for sth 也可作「保证某事属实」。

Definition (EN): in serious trouble
Quote from Episode: the last thing I want to do is get you in hot water
台词翻译: 我最不想做的就是把你牵扯进麻烦里。
Example Sentence: Two junior analysts got in hot water over the same spreadsheet.
例句翻译: 两个初级分析师因为同一份表格惹上了麻烦。
Usage Note: 同义 in a tight spot、in trouble。get in hot water＝惹祸。

Definition (EN): a wild scramble for something
Quote from Episode: some meth monkey had a feeding frenzy in here
台词翻译: 有个瘾君子在这儿翻箱倒柜翻疯了
Example Sentence: Reporters went into a feeding frenzy when the story broke.
例句翻译: 消息一出记者们立刻扑上去抢新闻。
Usage Note: 原义动物抢食。＝ frenzy 狂热；frantic 疯狂的。

Definition (EN): to watch something or someone closely
Quote from Episode: You got to keep a better watch over your turf.
台词翻译: 你得把自己的地盘看紧点。
Example Sentence: Someone needs to keep a watch over the loading bay at night.
例句翻译: 晚上得有人盯着装货区。
Usage Note: keep watch on／over。turf＝地盘（俚语）。

Definition (EN): to be on close friendly terms
Quote from Episode: you're sure you're tight with this guy?
台词翻译: 你确定你跟这家伙关系很好？
Example Sentence: He grew tight with the warehouse crew.
例句翻译: 他跟仓库那帮人混得很熟。
Usage Note: tight with＝关系近。tight with cash＝抠门。

Definition (EN): a really nice place
Quote from Episode: Sick crib, yo.
台词翻译: 这房子真带劲，老兄。
Example Sentence: His new crib has a rooftop deck.
例句翻译: 他新住处有屋顶露台。
Usage Note: 俚语。crib＝住处／房间。＝ dope／sick／ill。

Definition (EN): being honest and not pretending
Quote from Episode: You been keeping it real since you been sprung.
台词翻译: 你出来之后一直挺本分的。
Example Sentence: I appreciate that you keep it real with me.
例句翻译: 我很感谢你跟我说实话。
Usage Note: 口语。＝ being real、straight with me。

Definition (EN): released from custody
Quote from Episode: since you been sprung
台词翻译: 自从你被放出来
Example Sentence: He was sprung two weeks after the arrest.
例句翻译: 被捕两周后他就被放出来了。
Usage Note: slang。反义 locked up。也可作 spring 跳出。

Definition (EN): to start a conversation in an awkward situation
Quote from Episode: Break out the ice.
台词翻译: 来，share 一点。
Example Sentence: He opened with a joke to break the ice.
例句翻译: 他用一句玩笑破冰。
Usage Note: 源自破冰航行。职场社交/谈判开场必备。

Definition (EN): selling goods on behalf of a supplier
Quote from Episode: This is a consignment operation.
台词翻译: 我们这是寄售的生意。
Example Sentence: Consignment means the retailer only gets paid after the item sells.
例句翻译: 寄售意味着零售商要等货卖出去才拿钱。
Usage Note: ＝ consignment wholesale。寄售 vs 买断（buyout）。

Definition (EN): to provide money upfront and hope to recover it
Quote from Episode: You want me to float 35 G's?
台词翻译: 你要我先垫三万五？
Example Sentence: The vendor floated payroll until the invoice cleared.
例句翻译: 供应商先垫发了工资，等发票回款。
Usage Note: 职场财务义＝垫付。float income ＝非固定收入。

Definition (EN): paying immediately before delivery
Quote from Episode: Cash up front.
台词翻译: 现钱，一手交钱。
Example Sentence: Their policy is 50% cash up front and 50% on delivery.
例句翻译: 他们的政策是一半预付一半交货时付。
Usage Note: 职场/贸易。up front＝事先；预先。

Word / Phrase: I have two words for you
Definition (EN): my whole answer in one phrase
释义（中文）: 我给你两句话就说完了
Quote from Episode: I got two words for you: background check.
台词翻译: 我给你两句话：背景调查。
Example Sentence: Had I two words for you: read the contract.
例句翻译: 我给你两句话：把合同读完。
Usage Note: 口语，强调答案极短。＝ long story short。

Definition (EN): that is just how I operate
释义（中文）: 我就是这么混的／这就是我的路数
Quote from Episode: because that's how I roll
台词翻译: 因为我就这德行
Example Sentence: I take the long way — that's how I roll.
例句翻译: 我就爱绕远路，这就是我的风格。
Usage Note: roll＝风格、路子。同类：that's just the way it is。

Definition (EN): to match a description of the suspect
Quote from Episode: Fit the profile.
台词翻译: 完全符合画像。
Example Sentence: His background fits the profile we drew up.
例句翻译: 他的背景符合我们梳理出来的画像。
Usage Note: 职场也常用：fits the profile for the role＝符合这个岗位的画像。

Definition (EN): official permission to search a place
Quote from Episode: we got a search warrant, and we tore old Hugo's house apart
台词翻译: 我们拿到了搜查令，把 Hugo 家翻了个底朝天
Example Sentence: They cannot enter without a search warrant.
例句翻译: 没有搜查令他们不能进去。
Usage Note: arrive vs execute a warrant。同类 warrant＝授权令。

Definition (EN): to search it thoroughly and messily
Quote from Episode: we tore old Hugo's house apart
台词翻译: 我们把 Hugo 家翻了个底朝天
Example Sentence: Auditors tore the books apart looking for the gap.
例句翻译: 审计为了找账目缺口把账翻了个遍。
Usage Note: tear apart 也可指「拆解分析」，＝ break down。

Definition (EN): a habitual cannabis user
Quote from Episode: Turns out he's a major league pothead.
台词翻译: 结果他是个十足的大麻鬼。
Example Sentence: major league pothead ＝ 严重的大麻瘾者
例句翻译: （例句同上）
Usage Note: 俚语。major league＝「严重的/顶级的」，职场也用（major league screw-up＝天大的失误）。

Definition (EN): to give someone a particular impression
释义（中文）: 给人的感觉是；让人觉得
Quote from Episode: Hugo just doesn't strike me as the thief.
台词翻译: Hugo 给我完全不像小偷的感觉。
Example Sentence: Her pitch struck me as too polished to be true.
例句翻译: 她的提案给我的感觉是打磨过头，不像是真的。
Usage Note: it strikes me（that）＝ 我觉得。形容词的近义：come across as。

Definition (EN): to get past checks that should have caught it
释义（中文）: 从缝隙里漏过去；被蒙混过关
Quote from Episode: How could something like that just slip through the cracks?
台词翻译: 这种事怎么能就这么漏过去呢？
Example Sentence: A contractor with an expired licence slipped through the checks.
例句翻译: 一个执照过期的承包商混过了审查。
Usage Note: 职场质量管理高频。＝ fall between the cracks。

Definition (EN): as a minor concession of value
释义（中文）: 说句公道话；不过怎么说呢
Quote from Episode: I mean, for what it's worth
台词翻译: 怎么说呢，参考一下
Example Sentence: For what it's worth, I read the whole document.
例句翻译: 说句公道话，整份文件我看了。
Usage Note: 缓冲语。也可作 for what it is（就其价值而言）。
